cars.specification_market: Original 550-bhp supercharged Vantage, introduced in 1993 according to the manufacturer 2020 history after its 1992 show launch. Conservative family grouping includes related original Virage, V8 Coupe/Volante and supercharged Vantage versions once; it does not assert identical construction. Nine attributes use the specified manufacturer passages. Displacement 5340 cc follows the 2020 history; past-model table prints conflicting 5430 cc and is not silently corrected or used for that field. Conflicting 1990/1920-kg masses omitted, as are output rpm, converted units, acceleration, maximum speed and unqualified largest/most-powerful claims. No V600/Le Mans output, brakes or trim transferred. Photo is a separately labelled 1994 V550, with source-reported 1995 registration disagreement, representative of coupe/body only. Earlier carburetted V8 Vantage, DB2/DB7 Vantage grades and later VH/V12 Vantages are not this programme. No prototype, racer, replica or additional body/upgrade count.
cars.summary: The Virage-based supercharged Vantage is a distinctive 1990s British performance GT: two Eaton superchargers give its V8 a manufacturer-reported 550 bhp, matched by large ventilated front brakes and four-piston AP Racing calipers. Its substantial engineering makes it an important performance chapter beyond the earlier carburetted Vantage. Count the original Virage-based road programme once, without multiplying bodies, upgrades or commemorative editions.
